context.body: Memory of exodus, Davidic promise, and present kingship converge at dedication.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Solomon assembles Israel, priests bring the ark, a cloud fills the house, and Solomon blesses the assembly.
observations.label: The ark enters and glory fills the house: action

observations.body: Priests withdraw because of the cloud; the king interprets fulfillment of the promise to David.
observations.label: The ark enters and glory fills the house: response

payload.posture: Read 1 Kings 8:1–21 as ark, prayer, and dedication evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The house receives the ark and glory while the prayer that follows denies that God can be contained.
payload.title: The ark enters and glory fills the house
